segments.contextBefore: `apns-request-id`
segments.contextAfter: A canonical UUID that’s the unique ID for this request. If an error occurs when processing the request, APNs includes this value when reporting the error to your server. Canonical UUIDs are 32 lowercase hexadecimal digits, displayed in five groups separated by hyphens in the form `8-4-4-4-12`; For example: `123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-4266554400a0`. If you omit this header, APNs creates a `UUID` for you and returns it in its response.
